args.code:
import sympy
from sympy import symbols, diff, solve

t = symbols('t', positive=True)
f_expr = ((2*t + 1)**3) / (3*t)

# Find derivative
f_prime = diff(f_expr, t)

# Solve for critical points
critical_points = solve(f_prime, t)

print("Critical points t:", critical_points)

# Evaluate f(t) at the critical point
t_min = critical_points[0]
f_min = f_expr.subs(t, t_min)
print("Minimum value f(t_min):", f_min)
